Marshmallow Root Powder has been used as a healing herb for centuries due to its anti-inflammatory properties. In skin care, Marshmallow Root Powder is reputed to soothe redness, relieve inflammation and retain moisture.

Try Marshmallow Root Powder in bath teas, soaps, toners, and face masks too!

description:
Description
Details

Menthol Crystals are obtained by freezing distilled peppermint oil which causes the oil to freeze into crystals. 
Menthol is well known for its anti-fungal and anti-bacteria properties. Because of its characteristic aroma, and its cooling effect, Menthol Crystals are used in perfumes, cosmetics, analgesic balms, lotions, creams, shampoos and conditioners. Menthol Crystals are a great addition to foot care products such as scrubs, creams and lotions.
